0.headline: SFC Environmental Technologies IPO subscribed 4% so far on Day 1; check latest GMP
0.heading: SFC Environmental Technologies IPO subscribed 4% so far on Day 1; check latest GMP
0.intro: SFC Environmental Technologies, a Navi Mumbai-based wastewater treatment and environmental technology solutions provider, opened its initial public offering (IPO) today, with the issue receiving 4 percent subscription by 11:40 am on October 27, as per NSE data.
0.body:
SFC Environmental Technologies, a Navi Mumbai-based wastewater treatment and environmental technology solutions provider, opened its initial public offering (IPO) today, with the issue receiving 4 percent subscription by 11:40 am on October 27, as per NSE data.

The Rs 667.5 crore IPO recorded bids for 5,95,485 shares against 1,41,59,744 shares on offer. Retail investors led the demand with 7 percent subscription, followed by non-institutional investors with 2 percent subscription.

In the grey market, the SFC Environmental Technologies shares were commanding a grey market premium of 6 percent o the morning of October 27, as per Investorgain.

Read Also: BLS Polymers IPO fully subscribed in opening hour; GMP at 27%

The company has fixed the IPO price band at Rs 313–330 per share. At the upper end of the price band, SFC Environmental Technologies is valued at Rs 3,232.5 crore.

The grey market premium is an unofficial indicator of investor sentiment towards a public issue before its listing. However, it does not guarantee listing gains, and the premium can fluctuate depending on market conditions and investor demand.

The IPO comprises a fresh issue of Rs 150 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 1.56 crore equity shares worth Rs 517.5 crore. While the proceeds from the fresh issue will go to the company, the OFS component will allow existing shareholders, including promoters, to sell their shares.

Investors can bid for a minimum of 45 equity shares and in multiples of 45 shares thereafter.

At the upper end of the price band of Rs 330 per share, the minimum investment for retail investors will be Rs 14,850. The maximum investment for a retail investor under the individual retail category will be Rs 1,93,050, equivalent to 585 shares.

The company's shares are expected to list on the stock exchanges on November 3.

Check IPO News Here

The company posted a profit of Rs 1.5 crore in the first quarter of FY27, compared with a loss of Rs 1.3 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.

Revenue nearly doubled to Rs 133.9 crore in the quarter ended June 2026, from Rs 67.8 crore in the year-ago period.

The company plans to use Rs 42.2 crore from the net proceeds of the fresh issue to repay debt and Rs 74.9 crore to meet working capital requirements. The remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

About SFC Environmental Technologies

Incorporated in 2005, SFC Environmental Technologies provides engineering solutions across wastewater treatment, wastewater recycling and reuse, and solid waste treatment.

1.headline: BLS Polymers IPO fully subscribed in opening hour; GMP at 27%
1.heading: BLS Polymers IPO fully subscribed in opening hour; GMP at 27%
1.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) for BLS Polymers opened today, with the issue receiving 1.3 times subscription by 11:00 am on October 27, as per NSE data.
1.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) for BLS Polymers opened today, with the issue receiving 1.3 times subscription by 11:00 am on October 27, as per NSE data.

The Rs 255-crore IPO received bids for 1,56,78,300 shares against 1,19,00,000 shares on offer. The non-institutional investors led the demand with 2.03 times subscription, followed by retail investors with 1.77 times subscription.

Meanwhile, BLS Polymers shares were commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of around 27 percent on the morning of October 27, according to InvestorGain. The grey market premium is an unofficial indicator of investor sentiment towards an IPO ahead of its stock market debut. It does not guarantee the listing price or returns.

Read Also: EAAA India Alternatives IPO subscribed 12% so far on Day 2; check latest GMP

BLS Polymers has fixed the price band for its IPO at Rs 142-150 per share. At the upper end of the price band, the company is valued at approximately Rs 930.5 crore.

The issue opened for subscription on October 27 and will close on October 29. The allotment is expected to be finalised on October 30, while the company's shares are scheduled to list on the stock exchanges on November 3.

Ahead of the public issue, BLS Polymers raised Rs 76.5 crore through its anchor book. The company allotted 51 lakh equity shares to six institutional investors at Rs 150 per share, the upper end of the price band.

The IPO comprises a fresh issue of 1.7 crore equity shares. The company plans to use the proceeds to expand its manufacturing capacity, meet working capital requirements and fund general corporate purposes.

BLS Polymers plans to allocate Rs 77.56 crore from the net IPO proceeds towards expanding its existing manufacturing facility in Goa. The proposed expansion will increase the production capacity of select products.

Another Rs 89.5 crore has been earmarked for working capital requirements, while the remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

The capacity expansion is expected to support the company's manufacturing operations as it caters to industries such as power, telecommunications, railways, water, and oil and gas distribution.

Check IPO News Here

BLS Polymers reported a net profit of Rs 27 crore in the financial year ended March 2026, marking an increase of 27.8% from Rs 21.1 crore in FY25. Revenue from operations rose 6.4% year-on-year to Rs 349.4 crore in FY26, compared with Rs 328.4 crore in the previous financial year.

For the quarter ended June 2026, the company reported a net profit of Rs 10.2 crore on revenue of Rs 107.02 crore.

Unistone Capital has been appointed as the merchant banker managing the BLS Polymers IPO.

About BLS Polymers

Based in New Delhi, BLS Polymers manufactures custom-formulated polymer compounds in different grades for industrial applications.

Its products are used as raw materials for the sheathing, jacketing and insulation of wires and cables deployed across the power, telecommunications and railway sectors. The company's polymer compounds are also used to coat underground oil, gas and water pipelines, helping protect them against corrosion and external environmental factors.

BLS Polymers currently manufactures its products at a facility in Goa, which is equipped with 11 dedicated production machines.

2.headline: EAAA India Alternatives IPO subscribed 12% so far on Day 2; check latest GMP
2.heading: EAAA India Alternatives IPO subscribed 12% so far on Day 2; check latest GMP
2.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of EAAA India Alternatives continued to witness subdued demand on the second day of bidding, with the issue receiving 12 percent subscription by 10:30 am on October 27, according to data from the National Stock Exchange (NSE).
2.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of EAAA India Alternatives continued to witness subdued demand on the second day of bidding, with the issue receiving 12 percent subscription by 10:30 am on October 27, according to data from the National Stock Exchange (NSE).

The Rs 1,200-crore IPO received bids for 6,58,503 shares against 52,99,684 shares on offer.

Among investor categories, the non-institutional investor (NII) category led the demand, subscribing to 33 percent of its allotted portion, while the retail portion received bids for 6 percent of the shares reserved for the category.

In the grey market, the EAAA India Alternatives IPO was commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of nearly 1 percent on the morning of October 27, according to InvestorGain.

The grey market premium is an unofficial indicator of investor sentiment towards a public issue before its listing. However, it does not guarantee listing gains, and the premium can fluctuate depending on market conditions and investor demand.

The Rs 1,200-crore public issue will remain open for subscription from October 26 to October 28. The company has fixed the price band at Rs 1,585-1,665 per share.

The IPO is entirely an offer-for-sale (OFS), through which promoter entity Edelweiss Securities and Investments will sell its stake in the company.

Since the issue comprises only an offer-for-sale, the company will not receive any proceeds from the IPO. The proceeds, excluding offer-related expenses, will go to the selling shareholder.

Ahead of the public issue, EAAA India Alternatives raised Rs 360 crore through its anchor book. The anchor investors included Government Pension Fund Global, Schroder International, Hornbill Capital Advisors, Goldman Sachs and BNP Paribas Financial Markets.

Axis Capital, Jefferies India, Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors and Nuvama Wealth Management are acting as the merchant bankers to the issue.

Check IPO News Here

EAAA India Alternatives operates primarily across two business verticals: real assets and private credit. It also offers portfolio management services and focuses on managing long-term capital.

As of June 2026, the company had assets under management (AUM) of Rs 95,344.8 crore.

Under its real assets business, the company invests in infrastructure and commercial real estate assets through a combination of equity, quasi-equity and debt instruments.

Its private credit business provides credit and flexible financing solutions to borrowers. These investments allow the company to participate in alternative investment opportunities beyond traditional listed equity and debt markets.
